where.test: R1: a check has no expiry: years later, nothing else done, it still reads held
R1: a pre-flight with one blocker answers R34's {ready: false, first, blockers} and writes nothing: no preparation, no check (control: the same act ready writes both)
R1: a ready pre-flight stores the preparation (case-authoring R14) and records the check {check, case, edition, doc_sha, members, checked_at, by}, answering {ok, held, check, caseDocument}
R1: a refusal or a throw of the act after the pre-flight rolls everything back: a rolled-back R1 leaves no row
R1: a repeat while the latest check of that edition reads held answers that check with existed: true, writing nothing; once void, a repeat makes a new check (control)
R1: every refusal is the pre-flight's, in its order; MACHINE_CANNOT_PUBLISH and the owner-only authority come first, unchanged
R1: only the same act is a repeat: an edited statement over the same members prepares again and records a new check, voiding the first (document_replaced); another owner's act is their own check
R1: op=publishcheck takes author and viewer from the query after the body, gathers case-authoring R56's facts first and hands them to the pre-flight and the act
R2 (T46; N907, K2833): each lapse cause is latched: a lapse made after the check and undone before the read reads void with that why (control: nothing lapsed since the check reads held)
R2 (T46): a lapse undone before the check was made does not void it, and a lapse still standing does (controls for the latch)
R2 (T46): a replaced preparation or a moved member stays void when undone, beside the lapse causes
R2: a void check stays void when its cause is undone (a preparation stored again is a new one; a finding's new version is a new sha): re-running R1 makes a new check, which reads held
R2: an untouched check reads held, with checked_at and by; it is found by the check, by the edition, and by the case's latest prepared edition alike
R2: it writes nothing, and op=casecheck reads its viewer from the query, a call with no stamp fenced as no one
R2: member_moved is latched: a member moved and moved back to the pinned sha (a reverted bundle.md) still reads moved, by its commit count (control: untouched, held)
R2: none when there is no check: a case prepared and never checked, an edition with none, a check not of that case; checked_at and by are not answered
R2: published, with the edition, once that edition is ratified (publication R40's published_cases)

R2: the caseCheckOfNoSuchCase fixture is caseCheckOf's real refusal for a viewer without standing — NO_SUCH_CASE, byte-identical to a case that is not there, while a participant reads the held state — made afresh at call time, writing nothing

R2: undetermined when any read fails (each lapse read throwing or answering outside its shape, the checked text unreadable): it fails closed, never held, and never throws (control: the same check reads held)

R2: void document_replaced when the stored preparation of that case edition is no longer at doc_sha: a re-authored acknowledgement list (case-authoring R20) voids it, and so does a new preparation (control: held before)
R2: void member_moved names each member whose current bundle_sha is not the one pinned (control: the other member, unmoved, is not named)

R2: void source_lapsed, accepted_work_lapsed and marks_lapsed, each when case-carriage answers a row over the checked text, from the check's checked_at (its R21, R19 read as the check's by, R20); several causes are each named, in R2's order

R2: with viewer it is fenced as publication R1 is: no standing in the case's project answers NO_SUCH_CASE (C-148.1), byte-identical to an absent case; a participant reads the state; without viewer it is read as the plane

R3: every check reading held whose members include the finding, {case, edition, project, version_sha, role, check, checked_at}; version and project filter; a finding no held check names answers []

R1: a ready pre-flight stores the preparation (case-authoring R14) and records the check {check, case, edition, doc_sha, members, checked_at, by}, answering {ok, held, check, caseDocument}
R1: a pre-flight with one blocker answers R34's {ready: false, first, blockers} and writes nothing: no preparation, no check (control: the same act ready writes both)
R1: every refusal is the pre-flight's, in its order; MACHINE_CANNOT_PUBLISH and the owner-only authority come first, unchanged
R1: a refusal or a throw of the act after the pre-flight rolls everything back: a rolled-back R1 leaves no row
R1: a repeat while the latest check of that edition reads held answers that check with existed: true, writing nothing; once void, a repeat makes a new check (control)
R1: only the same act is a repeat: an edited statement over the same members prepares again and records a new check, voiding the first (document_replaced); another owner's act is their own check
R1: a check has no expiry: years later, nothing else done, it still reads held
R1: op=publishcheck takes author and viewer from the query after the body, gathers case-authoring R56's facts first and hands them to the pre-flight and the act
R4: checks are append-only: a later check, a void, a ratification and every read leave each earlier row byte-identical

R4: declared to record-core's purge as working material: the whole-store purge clears a check of an unsigned preparation with it and keeps one of a ratified edition (control); a bundle purge clears none
R4: no answer composes a case-level strength, and none names a place
R5: held, void (each why) and undetermined are answered as states, never faults: ok true, no refusal row, and each carries its key (case.check.held, case.check.void.<why>, case.check.undetermined)
R2: an untouched check reads held, with checked_at and by; it is found by the check, by the edition, and by the case's latest prepared edition alike

R2: void document_replaced when the stored preparation of that case edition is no longer at doc_sha: a re-authored acknowledgement list (case-authoring R20) voids it, and so does a new preparation (control: held before)
R2: void member_moved names each member whose current bundle_sha is not the one pinned (control: the other member, unmoved, is not named)

R2: void source_lapsed, accepted_work_lapsed and marks_lapsed, each when case-carriage answers a row over the checked text, from the check's checked_at (its R21, R19 read as the check's by, R20); several causes are each named, in R2's order
R2: member_moved is latched: a member moved and moved back to the pinned sha (a reverted bundle.md) still reads moved, by its commit count (control: untouched, held)
R2: a void check stays void when its cause is undone (a preparation stored again is a new one; a finding's new version is a new sha): re-running R1 makes a new check, which reads held
R2 (T46; N907, K2833): each lapse cause is latched: a lapse made after the check and undone before the read reads void with that why (control: nothing lapsed since the check reads held)
R2 (T46): a lapse undone before the check was made does not void it, and a lapse still standing does (controls for the latch)
R2 (T46): a replaced preparation or a moved member stays void when undone, beside the lapse causes

R2: undetermined when any read fails (each lapse read throwing or answering outside its shape, the checked text unreadable): it fails closed, never held, and never throws (control: the same check reads held)
R2: published, with the edition, once that edition is ratified (publication R40's published_cases)
R2: none when there is no check: a case prepared and never checked, an edition with none, a check not of that case; checked_at and by are not answered

R2: with viewer it is fenced as publication R1 is: no standing in the case's project answers NO_SUCH_CASE (C-148.1), byte-identical to an absent case; a participant reads the state; without viewer it is read as the plane
R2: it writes nothing, and op=casecheck reads its viewer from the query, a call with no stamp fenced as no one
R3: every check reading held whose members include the finding, {case, edition, project, version_sha, role, check, checked_at}; version and project filter; a finding no held check names answers []
R3: an id holding a character LIKE reads as its own (_, %, !) is found exactly, and a wildcard matches no other id (control: the plain id beside it)
R3: a void check is not listed, beside a held one (control); a published one is not listed either (publication R37 lists it)
R3: an undetermined check is not listed (fail closed), and a superseded check of the same edition never is
R3: NO_ID (C-148.2) for an empty finding, reading nothing (control: a finding read); viewer-free; it writes nothing
